title: Ay Akbar Ye Sehra
body:
akbar akbar haye akbar
akbar mera sehriyan waala akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
ay akbar ye sehra sajane ke din thay
kahan teri mayyat uthane ke din thay
<<DIVIDER>>
wo galiyan jahan tera bachpan hai guzra
jahan dekhte hai sabhi tera rasta
wahin laut ke ab to jaane ke din thay
ay akbar ye sehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai baithi hui dar pe bemaar sughra
tujhe lene aaunga tha jis se waada
behen ko watan se bulane ke din thay
ay akbar ye sehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
tujhe naaz se aise paala phupi ne
duayein tujhe di hai khud zindagi ne
nigahon may tujhko basane ke din thay
ay akbar ye sehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
shahe deen ye laashe pe kehte hai ro kar
sukoon kaise paaye bhala qalb e muztar
sahara tera ab to paane ke din thay
ay akbar ye sehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek subha maadar ne jab tujhko dekha
utaari nazar tera sadqa utaara
ay beta ye mannat badhane ke din thay
ay akbar ye sehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
tadapte huwe keh rahi hai ye maadar
mere naujawan ay mere laal akbar
kaleje se tujhko lagane ke din thay
ay akbar ye sehra...
<<DIVIDER>>
tha izhaar aur shadman gham ka manzar
lipat kar jo laashe se kehti thi maadar
ye naushaah tujhko banane ke din thay
ay akbar ye sehra...
author: Ali Izhaar
